description: This file defines the GeminiService class that interfaces with the Google Gemini Generative AI API. It handles configuration, context formatting, conversation management, response generation, session titling, and document summarization. The class is part of a larger system that provides AI-powered question answering and chat functionalities.

classes.name: GeminiService
classes.description: Service class for interacting with Google Gemini API for text generation, summarization, and chat management.

methods.name: __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the GeminiService instance, loads API key from environment, and configures the model and safety settings.

methods.name: str _format_context(self, search_results: List[SearchResult])
methods.description: Formats a list of search results into a string suitable as contextual input for the model.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,str]] _build_conversation_history(self, messages: List[ChatMessage])
methods.description: Builds a truncated conversation history from recent ChatMessage instances for context in responses.

methods.name: str generate_response( self, user_message: str, context: Optional[List[SearchResult]] = None, conversation_history: Optional[List[ChatMessage]] = None )
methods.description: Generates a text response from the Gemini API based on user input, optional context, and conversation history.

methods.name: str generate_session_title(self, first_message: str, response: str)
methods.description: Creates a concise title for the chat session based on initial user message and response.

methods.name: str summarize_document(self, text: str, max_length: int = 500)
methods.description: Produces a summary of a given document content with a specified maximum length.
